stemMd: Which policy best follows the author's recommendation?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Keep model assumptions secret to preserve a clear rule.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Label all buildings outside one line risk-free.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Refuse any precaution because risk varies continuously.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Apply every possible precaution everywhere without considering cost.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Publish risk ranges and model assumptions, then explain why a chosen level triggers a specified precaution.

explanationMd: The recommendation has two components: communicate uncertainty and justify the threshold. The keyed policy performs both, preserving an actionable rule without claiming that its boundary eliminates risk.

distractorRationale.b: That makes the categorical promise the passage criticizes.
distractorRationale.c: The author says this would leave preventable damage.
distractorRationale.d: The passage warns this may be disproportionate.
distractorRationale.a: Clarity should not come at the expense of transparency.
